blocks.en: Overview: Scope, Dual Compliance Obligations and Regulatory Architecture

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 解釋 FDCA §501(a)(2)(B) 如何將「不符合 CGMP」與「藥品摻假（adulteration）」掛鉤，理解 FDA 的執法基礎
blocks.en: Explain how FDCA §501(a)(2)(B) links "failure to comply with CGMP" to drug adulteration, and understand the basis of FDA enforcement

blocks.zh: 區分 21 CFR Part 210 與 Part 211 的角色：前者為「總則框架」，後者為「具體 CGMP 要求」
blocks.en: Distinguish the roles of 21 CFR Part 210 and Part 211: Part 210 is the general framework, while Part 211 contains the specific CGMP requirements

blocks.zh: 掌握 21 CFR 210.3 中所有核心定義，能在批次記錄、偏差調查及驗證文件中正確運用
blocks.en: Master all of the core definitions in 21 CFR 210.3 and apply them correctly in batch records, deviation investigations and validation documents

blocks.zh: 說明雙重合規架構對生物製劑 CDMO 的意涵：同時遵守 21 CFR Part 211 與 Part 600 的要求，且衝突時以更具體的法規優先
blocks.en: Explain what the dual compliance architecture means for a biologics CDMO: it must comply with both 21 CFR Part 211 and Part 600, and where they conflict the more specific regulation takes precedence

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 查廠準備角度，理解 FDA 如何以 21 CFR 210/211 為框架開立 483 觀察事項和 Warning Letter
blocks.en: From the standpoint of CDMO inspection readiness, understand how FDA uses 21 CFR 210/211 as the framework for issuing Form 483 observations and Warning Letters

blocks.zh: 0.1 Regulatory Basis & FDCA Link 0.1 法規基礎與 FDCA 連結
blocks.en: 0.1 Regulatory Basis & FDCA Link

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FDCA 501(a)(2)(B) — 法規執法的根基
blocks.en: Core Concept: FDCA 501(a)(2)(B) - The Foundation of Regulatory Enforcement

blocks.zh: FDCA §501(a)(2)(B) 是整個 CGMP 制度的法律支柱，理解這個條款才能看懂 FDA 的執法邏輯。
blocks.en: FDCA §501(a)(2)(B) is the legal pillar of the entire CGMP system. You need to understand this provision to follow FDA's enforcement logic.

blocks.zh:
關鍵：不需要造成傷害才算違法
這個條款採取「推定摻假（deemed adulterated）」機制。只要製造方法或設施控制不符合 CGMP，藥品就「被視為摻假」——無論那批藥最後是否真的有品質問題。這意味著：
blocks.en:
Key point: no harm is required for a violation
This provision uses a "deemed adulterated" mechanism. If the methods used in manufacture or the facility controls do not comply with CGMP, the drug is "deemed adulterated", regardless of whether that batch actually turns out to have a quality problem. This means:

blocks.zh: FDA 不必等到病患受害才能採取行動
blocks.en: FDA does not have to wait until patients are harmed before it acts

blocks.zh: 即使成品檢驗結果全部合格，若過程違反 CGMP，仍構成違法
blocks.en: Even if all finished-product test results pass, a process that violates CGMP is still a violation

blocks.zh: 責任人（responsible person）與藥品本身都可成為法規行動的對象
blocks.en: Both the responsible person and the drug itself can be the target of regulatory action

blocks.zh:
CGMP 是「最低標準（minimum standard）」
21 CFR 210.1(a) 明確寫道 minimum current good manufacturing practice。這句話非常重要：法規規定的是「不得低於此標準」，而非「做到這樣就夠了」。ICH Q10 的製藥品質系統（PQS）和生命週期管理方法，都是在 CGMP 最低標準之上的自願性精進。
blocks.en:
CGMP is a "minimum standard"
21 CFR 210.1(a) states explicitly minimum current good manufacturing practice. This wording is very important: the regulation says "you must not fall below this standard", not "this is enough". The ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system (PQS) and lifecycle management approach are voluntary enhancements built on top of the CGMP minimum.

blocks.zh: 定義實務應用：為什麼這些定義在工廠現場很重要？
blocks.en: Practical Use of the Definitions: Why Do They Matter on the Shop Floor?

blocks.zh:
Batch vs. Lot 的差異
在許多人眼中，batch 和 lot 是同義詞，但 FDA 定義不同：一個 batch 可以分割為多個 lot（如無菌充填時，一批原液分兩次充填，每次構成一個 lot）。批次記錄中，批號（batch number）和批次量（batch size）必須清晰對應到這些定義。
blocks.en:
Batch vs. lot
Many people treat batch and lot as synonyms, but FDA defines them differently: one batch can be divided into several lots (for example, in aseptic filling, a single bulk solution is filled in two runs and each run constitutes a lot). In the batch record, the batch number and batch size must correspond clearly to these definitions.

blocks.zh:
Lot Number 的法規意義
Lot number 必須能追溯「完整歷史」(complete history)，包括製造、加工、包裝、保存、發行的每一步。這是可追溯性（traceability）的法規基礎，也是偏差調查（deviation investigation）的起點。無法從 lot number 追溯到全部記錄，就是 §211.188 批次記錄的違規。
blocks.en:
Regulatory significance of the lot number
The lot number must allow the "complete history" to be traced, covering every step of manufacture, processing, packing, holding and distribution. This is the regulatory basis of traceability and the starting point of a deviation investigation. If you cannot trace from the lot number to all of the records, that is a violation of the §211.188 batch record requirements.

blocks.zh:
Component vs. Drug Substance
Component 是廣義的「原料/成分」，包含活性成分（API）和賦形劑；drug substance 特指具藥理活性的 API。辨別這個差異對進貨管制（§211.80–211.99）和標示管理非常重要。
blocks.en:
Component vs. drug substance
A component is broadly any "raw material/ingredient", including the active ingredient (API) and excipients; a drug substance refers specifically to the pharmacologically active API. Telling the two apart matters a great deal for incoming material control (§211.80-211.99) and labeling control.

blocks.zh:
Theoretical Yield / Actual Yield / % Theoretical Yield
§211.192 規定批次記錄回顧時，必須評估 yield 是否在核准範圍內（§211.188(b)(11)）。超出範圍的 yield 偏差必須調查。CDMO 工廠中，yield 管控是最常見的 483 觀察項目之一：未建立 yield limits、或 yield 超出範圍未調查即放行。
blocks.en:
Theoretical yield / actual yield / percentage of theoretical yield
§211.192 requires that, during batch record review, yield be evaluated against the approved range (§211.188(b)(11)). Yield deviations outside the range must be investigated. In CDMO plants, yield control is one of the most common Form 483 observations: yield limits not established, or yield outside the range released without investigation.

blocks.zh: 常見缺失警示
blocks.en: Common Deficiency Warnings

blocks.zh:
Phase 1 臨床試驗用藥的例外
§210.2(c) 說明 Phase 1 臨床試驗用藥（investigational drug）不適用 Part 211 全部要求，但適用 FDCA 安全性相關規定。CDMO 在接受 Phase 1 委託時，必須確認適用的是何版本的要求，以及客戶是否有 Phase 1 的具體品質協議（Quality Agreement）。一旦進入 Phase 2/3，Part 211 全部適用。
blocks.en:
Exception for Phase 1 investigational drugs
§210.2(c) states that Phase 1 investigational drugs are not subject to all of the Part 211 requirements, although the safety-related provisions of the FDCA still apply. When a CDMO accepts Phase 1 work, it must confirm which version of the requirements applies and whether the client has a specific Phase 1 Quality Agreement. Once a product moves into Phase 2/3, Part 211 applies in full.

blocks.zh:
Phase 1 例外的邊界：哪些仍然適用？
即使 Part 211 大部分條款對 Phase 1 不強制，以下要求在實務上仍被 FDA 和客戶期望遵守：
blocks.en:
Limits of the Phase 1 exception: what still applies?
Even though most Part 211 provisions are not mandatory for Phase 1, FDA and clients still expect the following in practice:

blocks.zh: 身份鑑定（Identity Testing）： 即使是 Phase 1，每批 API 和關鍵賦形劑仍應做身份確認，這是安全性（safety）的基本要求，不是 CGMP 要求
blocks.en: Identity testing: Even for Phase 1, every batch of API and critical excipients should still be identity tested. This is a basic safety requirement, not a CGMP requirement

blocks.zh: 基本批次記錄： 需要有足夠的製造記錄，能在不良事件（adverse event）調查時追溯批次歷史
blocks.en: Basic batch records: There must be sufficient manufacturing records to trace the batch history during an adverse event investigation

blocks.zh: 無菌保證（如適用）： 注射劑 Phase 1 仍須達到無菌，否則直接違反 FDCA 安全性要求
blocks.en: Sterility assurance (where applicable): Injectable Phase 1 products must still be sterile; otherwise this is a direct violation of the FDCA safety requirements

blocks.zh: 標示正確性： 臨床試驗用藥標示錯誤（如劑量、儲存條件）可能直接危及受試者安全，不在 Phase 1 例外範圍
blocks.en: Labeling accuracy: Errors in the labeling of clinical trial drugs (such as dose or storage conditions) can directly endanger subjects, so labeling is outside the Phase 1 exception

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議： 即使 Phase 1 法規要求較寬鬆，多數 CDMO 會選擇以接近 Part 211 的標準製造 Phase 1 用藥，原因是：(1) 客戶通常要求；(2) 建立完整記錄有助於後期臨床和商業申請；(3) 避免在 Phase 1 → Phase 2 過渡時出現品質標準落差。
blocks.en: CDMO practical advice: Even though the Phase 1 regulatory requirements are looser, most CDMOs choose to manufacture Phase 1 drugs to a standard close to Part 211, because: (1) clients usually require it; (2) complete records help later clinical work and commercial filings; (3) it avoids a gap in quality standards at the Phase 1 → Phase 2 transition.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 的環境監控系統顯示某次無菌充填的微生物超標，但成品無菌試驗通過、放行了。FDA 能以什麼法律依據對這批藥採取行動？
blocks.en: A CDMO's environmental monitoring system shows a microbial excursion during an aseptic filling run, but the finished product passed the sterility test and was released. On what legal basis can FDA take action against this batch?

blocks.zh: 一批原液（API solution）分三次充填，得到三個批次的注射劑。「批號」如何設定，才能從每個批號追溯回原液的完整製程記錄？
blocks.en: One bulk API solution is filled in three runs, producing three batches of injectable product. How should batch numbers be assigned so that each batch number can be traced back to the complete process records of the bulk solution?

blocks.zh: 某充填批次的 actual yield 為 97.2%，而核准的 theoretical yield 範圍是 95.0%–102.0%。需要調查嗎？若 actual yield 為 103.5%，呢？
blocks.en: The actual yield of a filling batch is 97.2%, and the approved theoretical yield range is 95.0%-102.0%. Is an investigation needed? What if the actual yield is 103.5%?

blocks.zh: 0.2 Dual Compliance Architecture 0.2 雙重合規架構
blocks.en: 0.2 Dual Compliance Architecture

blocks.zh: 雙重合規架構：製藥 CDMO vs. 生物製劑 CDMO
blocks.en: Dual Compliance Architecture: Pharmaceutical CDMO vs. Biologics CDMO

blocks.zh: 理解 Part 210 / Part 211 / Part 600 的層次關係，是 CDMO 合規管理的基礎。
blocks.en: Understanding how Part 210, Part 211 and Part 600 relate to one another is the foundation of CDMO compliance management.

blocks.zh: 一般製藥 CDMO（小分子、非生物製劑）：
blocks.en: General pharmaceutical CDMO (small molecules, non-biologics):

blocks.zh: 主要法規框架：21 CFR Part 211
blocks.en: Main regulatory framework: 21 CFR Part 211

blocks.zh: 通用定義：21 CFR Part 210
blocks.en: General definitions: 21 CFR Part 210

blocks.zh: 罰則基礎：FDCA §501(a)(2)(B)
blocks.en: Basis for penalties: FDCA §501(a)(2)(B)

blocks.zh: 生物製劑 CDMO（mAb、疫苗、細胞療法、基因療法）：
blocks.en: Biologics CDMO (mAbs, vaccines, cell therapy, gene therapy):

blocks.zh: 必須同時符合：21 CFR Part 211 AND 21 CFR Parts 600–680
blocks.en: Must comply with both: 21 CFR Part 211 AND 21 CFR Parts 600-680

blocks.zh: 衝突時：Part 600 系列（更具體）優先
blocks.en: In case of conflict: the Part 600 series (more specific) takes precedence

blocks.zh: 例如，Part 600.12 對記錄保存有額外要求，即使 Part 211.180 已有基本要求，兩套都需遵循；若兩者規定不同，取更嚴格的那套
blocks.en: For example, Part 600.12 has additional record retention requirements; even though Part 211.180 already has basic requirements, both sets must be followed, and where they differ, the stricter one applies

blocks.zh:
實務影響：
一個同時承接小分子與抗體藥物委託的 CDMO，其 QMS（Quality Management System）必須能區分不同產品線的適用法規。客戶稽核（client audit）和 FDA 查廠的清單也必須反映這種差異。一個常見的稽核發現是：某生物製劑 CDMO 的 SOP 只引用 Part 211，未整合 Part 600 的要求。
blocks.en:
Practical impact:
A CDMO that takes on both small-molecule and antibody programs must have a QMS (Quality Management System) that can distinguish the applicable regulations for each product line. Client audit and FDA inspection checklists must also reflect this difference. A common audit finding is a biologics CDMO whose SOPs cite only Part 211 and do not incorporate the Part 600 requirements.

blocks.zh: Part 211 §211.1(c) — 藥物原料（Drug Substance）在何種情況下適用 Part 211？
blocks.en: Part 211 §211.1(c) - When does Part 211 apply to a drug substance?

blocks.zh: §211.1(c) 說明 §§211.80–211.94（原料管制子章節）適用於用作 drug product components 的 drug substances。這意味著：
blocks.en: §211.1(c) states that §§211.80-211.94 (the component control subpart) apply to drug substances used as components of drug products. This means:

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 只做 API（藥物原料）合成，且 API 不會直接進入本廠製造的 drug product，則主要受 ICH Q7 和 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart E 規範，而非整部 Part 211
blocks.en: If a CDMO only synthesizes API (drug substance) and the API does not go directly into a drug product made at the same site, the site is mainly governed by ICH Q7 and 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart E, rather than the whole of Part 211

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 既做 API 又做製劑（finished dosage form），則 API 工序同時受 Part 211 Subpart E 和整體 Part 211 架構管轄
blocks.en: If a CDMO makes both API and finished dosage forms, the API operations are governed by both Part 211 Subpart E and the overall Part 211 framework

blocks.zh: 這個區分直接影響查廠範圍：FDA 到一個「API + finished drug」的 CDMO 查廠，會審查整個 Part 211，包含 Subpart E
blocks.en: This distinction directly affects inspection scope: when FDA inspects an "API + finished drug" CDMO, it will review the whole of Part 211, including Subpart E

blocks.zh: 生物製劑 CDMO 常見合規缺口
blocks.en: Common Compliance Gaps at Biologics CDMOs

blocks.zh: 以下是 FDA Warning Letter 中對生物製劑 CDMO 的常見觀察，源自未整合 Part 211 和 Part 600 的雙重要求：
blocks.en: The following are common observations made at biologics CDMOs in FDA Warning Letters, arising from a failure to integrate the dual requirements of Part 211 and Part 600:

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限不足： Part 600.12 對某些生物製劑（如血液製品）要求超過 Part 211.180 基本年限的保存期
blocks.en: Insufficient record retention period: Part 600.12 requires some biologics (such as blood products) to be retained for longer than the basic period in Part 211.180

blocks.zh: BLA 變更未申報： Part 601.12 要求 BLA 持有人向 FDA 申報製造工藝變更（Prior Approval Supplement / CBE-30 / Annual Report），但 CDMO 與客戶的 Quality Agreement 未明確分工，導致客戶不知變更需申報
blocks.en: BLA changes not reported: Part 601.12 requires the BLA holder to report manufacturing process changes to FDA (Prior Approval Supplement / CBE-30 / Annual Report), but the Quality Agreement between the CDMO and the client does not clearly divide responsibilities, so the client is unaware that a change must be reported

blocks.zh: 人員資格證明不足： Part 600.10 對從事生物製劑製造的人員有特定資格要求，比 Part 211.25 更具體
blocks.en: Insufficient evidence of personnel qualifications: Part 600.10 sets specific qualification requirements for personnel engaged in biologics manufacture, which are more specific than Part 211.25

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時生產口服固體製劑（OSD）和重組蛋白質注射劑（BLA 持有）。FDA 來查廠時，哪個產品線會被引用 Part 211 加上 Part 600？哪個只被引用 Part 211？
blocks.en: A CDMO produces both oral solid dosage (OSD) products and injectable recombinant proteins (BLA holder). When FDA inspects, which product line will be cited under Part 211 plus Part 600? Which will be cited under Part 211 only?

blocks.zh: Part 600.12 規定某種生物製劑記錄必須保存至「到期日後 10 年」，而 Part 211.180(b) 規定「到期日後 1 年」（或製造日後 3 年，取較長者）。發生衝突時，哪個規定優先？實際保存幾年？
blocks.en: Part 600.12 requires certain biologics records to be retained for "10 years after the expiration date", while Part 211.180(b) requires "1 year after the expiration date" (or 3 years after manufacture, whichever is longer). In case of conflict, which provision takes precedence? How many years are actually retained?

blocks.zh: 你是一家新成立的細胞療法 CDMO 的 QA Director。你的 SOP 體系應該涵蓋哪些 CFR Parts？（至少列出 3 個）
blocks.en: You are the QA Director of a newly established cell therapy CDMO. Which CFR Parts should your SOP system cover? (List at least 3.)

blocks.zh: 0.3 Regulatory Architecture: How FDA Uses 210/211 0.3 法規架構：FDA 如何運用 210/211
blocks.en: 0.3 Regulatory Architecture: How FDA Uses 210/211

blocks.zh: 查廠邏輯：FDA 如何用 210/211 開 483？
blocks.en: Inspection Logic: How Does FDA Use 210/211 to Issue a Form 483?

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA 查廠的思維框架，能幫助 CDMO 的 QA 團隊在查廠前有效準備。
blocks.en: Understanding FDA's inspection mindset helps a CDMO QA team prepare effectively before an inspection.

blocks.zh:
FDA 483 的法律性質
Form 483 本身不是「違規通知」，而是「查廠期間觀察到的可能違規事項清單」。每一條 483 觀察通常包含：
blocks.en:
The legal nature of FDA Form 483
Form 483 is not a "notice of violation"; it is a "list of possible violations observed during the inspection". Each 483 observation usually contains:

blocks.zh: 所引用的 CFR 條款（如 21 CFR 211.192）
blocks.en: The CFR provision cited (such as 21 CFR 211.192)

blocks.zh: 具體觀察到的情況（如「批次記錄中，步驟 X 的操作員初簽缺失，共 17 批次」）
blocks.en: The specific condition observed (such as "In the batch records, the operator initials for step X are missing, in 17 batches")

blocks.zh: 有時附有數據（如 OOS 調查未完成的批次比例）
blocks.en: Sometimes supporting data (such as the proportion of batches with incomplete OOS investigations)

blocks.zh: 關鍵觀念： FDA 引用的是 Part 211 的具體條款，而非 Part 210。Part 210 是背景框架，Part 211 才是 483 的引用基礎。
blocks.en: Key concept: FDA cites specific provisions of Part 211, not Part 210. Part 210 is the background framework; Part 211 is the basis for 483 citations.

blocks.zh:
從 483 到 Warning Letter 的升級邏輯
並非所有 483 觀察都會升級為 Warning Letter。升級的常見原因：
blocks.en:
Escalation logic from 483 to Warning Letter
Not every 483 observation escalates to a Warning Letter. Common reasons for escalation:

blocks.zh: 重複發現（上次查廠已開 483，這次同樣問題再次出現）
blocks.en: Repeat findings (a 483 was issued at the last inspection and the same problem appears again)

blocks.zh: 系統性缺失（不是單一事件，而是整個系統的失控）
blocks.en: Systemic failure (not a single event but a loss of control across the whole system)

blocks.zh: 數據完整性問題（FDA 認為這是最嚴重的 CGMP 缺失之一）
blocks.en: Data integrity problems (FDA regards these as among the most serious CGMP failures)

blocks.zh: CAPA 回覆不誠信或不充分
blocks.en: A dishonest or inadequate CAPA response

blocks.zh: 「地板而非天花板」的實務意涵
blocks.en: The Practical Meaning of "Floor, Not Ceiling"

blocks.zh: CGMP 最低標準 ≠ 目標標準
blocks.en: CGMP minimum standard ≠ target standard

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2014 年 CGMP 白皮書及歷次指引中反覆強調：CGMP 法規是防止最劣情況（藥品不安全、無效）的底線，不是品質工作的目標線。對 CDMO 而言，這有幾個重要實務涵義：
blocks.en: FDA has stressed repeatedly, in its 2014 CGMP white paper and in successive guidances, that the CGMP regulations are the floor that guards against the worst case (unsafe or ineffective drugs), not the target line for quality work. For a CDMO, this has several important practical implications:

blocks.zh: 客戶合約要求往往高於法規： 大型製藥客戶（Big Pharma originator）的技術協議（Technical Agreement）和品質協議（Quality Agreement）通常要求超過 CGMP 的標準，例如更短的偏差關閉時間、更嚴格的環境監控行動限制值
blocks.en: Client contract requirements are often higher than the regulations: The Technical Agreements and Quality Agreements of large pharmaceutical clients (Big Pharma originators) usually require more than the CGMP standard, for example shorter deviation closure times and stricter environmental monitoring action limits

blocks.zh: 進階方法不是加分而是期望： 對於晚期（Phase 3 / commercial）產品，FDA 在查廠時會期望看到 ICH Q10 的生命週期管理元素，例如持續製程驗證（CPV, Continued Process Verification）、年度產品品質回顧（APR/PQR）
blocks.en: Advanced approaches are an expectation, not a bonus: For late-stage (Phase 3 / commercial) products, FDA inspectors expect to see ICH Q10 lifecycle management elements, such as Continued Process Verification (CPV) and the Annual Product Review / Product Quality Review (APR/PQR)

blocks.zh: PAT 和 RTR 不在 Part 211 正文中，但 FDA 支持： 過程分析技術（PAT）和即時放行測試（RTRT）不被 Part 211 明文要求，但 FDA Guidance（2004 PAT Guidance、ICH Q8/Q10/Q11/Q12）鼓勵採用，且符合「超越 CGMP 最低標準」的精神
blocks.en: PAT and RTRT are not in the body of Part 211, but FDA supports them: Process analytical technology (PAT) and real-time release testing (RTRT) are not expressly required by Part 211, but FDA guidance (the 2004 PAT Guidance, ICH Q8/Q10/Q11/Q12) encourages their adoption, and they fit the spirit of going beyond the CGMP minimum

blocks.zh: CDMO 查廠準備的「高頻率 483 防守清單」
blocks.en: The CDMO Inspection Readiness "High-Frequency 483 Defense List"

blocks.zh: 基於 FDA 483 資料庫和 Warning Letter 統計，以下是對 CDMO 最常見的 Part 211 觀察項目，以及對應的準備重點：
blocks.en: Based on the FDA 483 database and Warning Letter statistics, the following are the Part 211 observations most common at CDMOs, with the corresponding preparation priorities:

blocks.zh:
1. §211.192 — 批次記錄回顧（Batch Record Review）
準備重點：確保所有批次記錄在放行前經 QU 完整回顧；所有偏差、異常已記錄並附有評估；yield 計算有記錄且在核准範圍內。常見缺失：eBR 系統電子簽名記錄不完整；操作員事後補記。
blocks.en:
1. §211.192 - Batch Record Review
Preparation priorities: Ensure all batch records are fully reviewed by the quality unit (QU) before release; all deviations and anomalies are recorded with an assessment; yield calculations are documented and within the approved range. Common deficiencies: incomplete electronic signature records in the eBR system; operators making entries after the fact.

blocks.zh:
2. §211.194 — 實驗室記錄（Lab Records）
準備重點：原始數據（raw data）完整保存；分析員即時記錄；LIMS 稽核追蹤未被關閉。常見缺失：LIMS/CDS 中的 audit trail 未啟用或可被管理員關閉（Part 11 問題）；OOS 調查未在 30 天內完成。
blocks.en:
2. §211.194 - Laboratory Records
Preparation priorities: Raw data are fully retained; analysts record contemporaneously; LIMS audit trails are not disabled. Common deficiencies: audit trails in LIMS/CDS not enabled or able to be disabled by an administrator (a Part 11 issue); OOS investigations not completed within 30 days.

blocks.zh:
3. §211.100 — 書面程序與偏差（Written Procedures & Deviations）
準備重點：所有 SOPs 有效受控；偏差 100% 記錄；CAPA 有指定負責人和完成日期；偏差關閉率和時效性定期追蹤。常見缺失：班次交接口頭溝通的偏差未記錄；偏差調查只描述現象不分析根本原因。
blocks.en:
3. §211.100 - Written Procedures & Deviations
Preparation priorities: All SOPs are effective and controlled; 100% of deviations are recorded; CAPAs have an assigned owner and completion date; deviation closure rate and timeliness are tracked regularly. Common deficiencies: deviations communicated only verbally at shift handover are not recorded; deviation investigations only describe the phenomenon without analyzing the root cause.

blocks.zh:
4. §211.68 — 電腦化系統（Computerized Systems）
準備重點：所有受 Part 11 管轄的系統有驗證記錄；稽核追蹤為電腦自動產生且不可關閉；存取權限管控有文件化記錄。常見缺失：系統「User ID 共用」；稽核追蹤日誌從未被定期回顧。
blocks.en:
4. §211.68 - Computerized Systems
Preparation priorities: All systems subject to Part 11 have validation records; audit trails are generated automatically by the computer and cannot be disabled; access control is documented. Common deficiencies: shared "User IDs" on a system; audit trail logs never reviewed periodically.

blocks.zh:
5. §211.22 — 品管單位職責（Quality Unit Responsibilities）
準備重點：QU 在組織上獨立於生產（organizational independence）；QU 有批次最終放行的實質授權，不受商業壓力干預；QU 人員數量與工廠規模相稱。常見缺失：QU Director 同時兼任生產相關職責；QU 因人員不足而「橡皮圖章式」放行。
blocks.en:
5. §211.22 - Quality Unit Responsibilities
Preparation priorities: The QU is organizationally independent of production; the QU has real authority for final batch release, free from commercial pressure; QU headcount is commensurate with the size of the plant. Common deficiencies: the QU Director also holds production-related duties; the QU "rubber-stamps" releases because of understaffing.

blocks.zh: Data Integrity — CGMP 中最高風險議題
blocks.en: Data Integrity - The Highest-Risk Topic in CGMP

blocks.zh: 近年來，FDA Warning Letter 中最常見且最嚴重的觀察類別是數據完整性（data integrity）缺失。雖然 Part 211 並無明文「數據完整性」條款，但 FDA 透過以下條款組合建立執法基礎：
blocks.en: In recent years, the most common and most serious category of observations in FDA Warning Letters has been data integrity failures. Although Part 211 has no express "data integrity" clause, FDA builds its enforcement basis from the following combination of provisions:

blocks.zh: §211.68（電腦化系統）— 系統必須準確再現數據、有稽核追蹤
blocks.en: §211.68 (computerized systems) - systems must reproduce data accurately and have audit trails

blocks.zh: §211.194（實驗室記錄）— 記錄必須及時、準確、完整
blocks.en: §211.194 (laboratory records) - records must be timely, accurate and complete

blocks.zh: §211.192（批次記錄回顧）— 批次記錄必須完整，偏差須調查
blocks.en: §211.192 (batch record review) - batch records must be complete, and deviations must be investigated

blocks.zh: §211.100（書面程序）— 程序必須被遵循，偏差須記錄
blocks.en: §211.100 (written procedures) - procedures must be followed, and deviations must be recorded

blocks.zh: CDMO 特殊風險： CDMO 常面臨「多客戶、多系統、多廠區」的複雜性，加上商業壓力（交期、產能）。這使得以下數據完整性風險特別容易發生：
blocks.en: Special CDMO risks: CDMOs often face the complexity of "multiple clients, multiple systems, multiple sites", together with commercial pressure (delivery dates, capacity). This makes the following data integrity risks particularly likely:

blocks.zh: 拒絕 OOS 結果後重新測試，未記錄初次測試（俗稱「cherry picking」）
blocks.en: Rejecting an OOS result and retesting without recording the initial test (commonly called "cherry picking")

blocks.zh: 後補或預簽原始記錄
blocks.en: Backdating or pre-signing original records

blocks.zh: LIMS/CDS 系統時鐘設定不一致，稽核追蹤時間戳不可信
blocks.en: Inconsistent clock settings across LIMS/CDS systems, so audit trail timestamps cannot be trusted

blocks.zh: 共享 User ID（無法歸責到個人）
blocks.en: Shared User IDs (actions cannot be attributed to an individual)

blocks.zh: 一旦 FDA 查廠發現數據完整性問題，通常直接升級為 Warning Letter，且可能觸發進口警報（Import Alert），阻止設施生產的產品進入美國市場。
blocks.en: Once FDA finds a data integrity problem during an inspection, it usually escalates directly to a Warning Letter and may trigger an Import Alert, preventing products made at the facility from entering the U.S. market.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員拿到一份 CDMO 的批次記錄，發現批次記錄上有 12 處由同一位員工「事後補簽」（簽名日期比記錄事件晚了 5 天），同時 LIMS 顯示有 2 次 OOS 結果在調查完成前被刪除。FDA 最可能引用哪些 Part 211 條款開立 483 觀察？可能升級為哪種法規行動？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator obtains a CDMO's batch records and finds 12 entries on the batch records that were "signed after the fact" by the same employee (the signature date is 5 days later than the recorded event), while LIMS shows that 2 OOS results were deleted before the investigation was completed. Which Part 211 provisions is FDA most likely to cite in 483 observations? What type of regulatory action could this escalate to?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 的 QA 總監說：「我們完全符合 21 CFR Part 211，所以我們是 CGMP 合規的，不用擔心 Warning Letter。」這個說法有什麼問題？從「地板非天花板」原則，如何反駁？
blocks.en: A CDMO's QA Director says: "We fully comply with 21 CFR Part 211, so we are CGMP compliant and don't need to worry about Warning Letters." What is wrong with this statement? How would you rebut it using the "floor, not ceiling" principle?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 剛剛接到一個新客戶的委託——一個 Phase 2 的重組蛋白質注射劑（有 IND，正在申請 BLA）。你的法規事務（RA）團隊應該評估哪些 CFR Parts 的適用性？Phase 2 和 Phase 3 的要求有何不同？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has just received a request from a new client for a Phase 2 recombinant protein injectable (with an IND, with a BLA in preparation). Which CFR Parts should your Regulatory Affairs (RA) team assess for applicability? How do the Phase 2 and Phase 3 requirements differ?

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 與 21 CFR 210/211 的整合框架
blocks.en: Integrated Framework of ICH Q10 and 21 CFR 210/211

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員（Investigator）在評估一家 CDMO 的品質系統時，心中有一個框架：CGMP 法規（Part 211）是「硬要求」，ICH Q10 是「期望的成熟度」。
blocks.en: When an FDA investigator evaluates the quality system of a CDMO, there is a framework in mind: the CGMP regulations (Part 211) are the "hard requirements", and ICH Q10 is the "expected level of maturity".

blocks.zh: 0.4 The Full CGMP Regulatory Universe: Where 210/211 Fit 0.4 完整的 CGMP 法規全貌：210/211 的定位
blocks.en: 0.4 The Full CGMP Regulatory Universe: Where 210/211 Fit

blocks.zh: 法規地圖：CDMO 的「地形感知」
blocks.en: The Regulatory Map: A CDMO's "Sense of Terrain"

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的 QA、RA 和法規合規人員而言，能夠快速定位「哪個 CFR Part 適用於手上這個產品」是核心專業能力。
blocks.en: For CDMO QA, RA and compliance professionals, being able to quickly locate "which CFR Parts apply to the product in hand" is a core professional skill.

blocks.zh: 判斷流程（決策樹）：
blocks.en: Decision flow (decision tree):

blocks.zh: 是藥品（drug product）嗎？ → 是 → Part 210/211 基礎適用
blocks.en: Is it a drug product? → Yes → Part 210/211 baseline applies

blocks.zh: 是生物製劑（biologic，有 BLA）嗎？ → 是 → 加上 Part 600–680
blocks.en: Is it a biologic (with a BLA)? → Yes → add Parts 600-680

blocks.zh: 是組合產品（combination product）嗎？ → 是 → 查 Part 4，可能加上 Part 820
blocks.en: Is it a combination product? → Yes → check Part 4; Part 820 may also apply

blocks.zh: 是 IND 階段嗎？Phase 1 嗎？ → 是 → §210.2(c) 例外，但安全性要求仍適用
blocks.en: Is it at the IND stage? Phase 1? → Yes → §210.2(c) exception, but the safety requirements still apply

blocks.zh: 有電子記錄嗎？ → 是 → Part 11 適用（predicate rule = Part 211 各條款）
blocks.en: Are there electronic records? → Yes → Part 11 applies (predicate rule = the relevant provisions of Part 211)

blocks.zh: 是 API（原料藥）合成設施嗎？ → 是 → 主要適用 ICH Q7（FDA 已採納），而非 Part 211 全部
blocks.en: Is it an API (drug substance) synthesis facility? → Yes → mainly ICH Q7 applies (adopted by FDA), rather than the whole of Part 211

blocks.zh: 一個複雜的 CDMO（同時生產 API + 製劑 + 生物製劑 + Phase 1/2 臨床用藥）可能同時面對 Part 4、Part 11、Part 210/211、Part 600、Part 312 的交叉適用。這需要一個清晰的「監管適用性矩陣（Regulatory Applicability Matrix）」作為法規管理工具。
blocks.en: A complex CDMO (producing API + finished product + biologics + Phase 1/2 clinical drugs at the same time) may face overlapping application of Part 4, Part 11, Part 210/211, Part 600 and Part 312. This calls for a clear "Regulatory Applicability Matrix" as a regulatory management tool.

blocks.zh: Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI)：CDMO 的「大考」
blocks.en: Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI): The CDMO's "Big Exam"

blocks.zh: 對許多 CDMO 而言，PAI 是最重要的 FDA 查廠類型，因為它直接決定客戶的新藥申請能否獲批。
blocks.en: For many CDMOs, the PAI is the most important type of FDA inspection, because it directly determines whether the client's new drug application is approved.

blocks.zh: PAI 觸發時機：
blocks.en: When a PAI is triggered:

blocks.zh: 客戶提交 NDA（505(b)(1) 或 505(b)(2)）或 ANDA（學名藥）
blocks.en: The client submits an NDA (505(b)(1) or 505(b)(2)) or an ANDA (generic drug)

blocks.zh: 客戶提交 BLA（生物製劑）
blocks.en: The client submits a BLA (biologic)

blocks.zh: 現有批准後重大製造工藝變更（Prior Approval Supplement）
blocks.en: A major manufacturing process change to an approved product (Prior Approval Supplement)

blocks.zh: PAI 重點檢查項目（直接對應 Part 211）：
blocks.en: Key PAI inspection areas (directly mapped to Part 211):

blocks.zh: 製程驗證批次（Process Validation Batches）的批次記錄（§211.188）
blocks.en: Batch records of the process validation batches (§211.188)

blocks.zh: 分析方法驗證（Analytical Method Validation）數據（§211.160, §211.194）
blocks.en: Analytical method validation data (§211.160, §211.194)

blocks.zh: 年度產品品質回顧（APR/PQR）是否建立（§211.180(e)）
blocks.en: Whether the APR/PQR has been established (§211.180(e))
Batch release procedures (§211.22, §211.192)
Change control records (§211.100, §211.68)

blocks.zh:
CDMO 常見 PAI 失敗原因：
驗證批次與申請中描述的製程不一致（製程在驗證後被「悄悄修改」，但未更新申請文件或進行重新驗證）。這個缺失同時違反 §211.100（未按書面程序）和《21 CFR 314 申請誠信政策》。
blocks.en:
Common reason CDMOs fail a PAI:
The validation batches are inconsistent with the process described in the application (the process was "quietly modified" after validation, but the application documents were not updated and no revalidation was performed). This deficiency violates both §211.100 (not following written procedures) and the Application Integrity Policy (21 CFR 314).

blocks.zh: 綜合練習：Section 0 整合應用
blocks.en: Comprehensive Exercise: Integrated Application of Section 0

blocks.zh: 監管適用性矩陣： 一家 CDMO 同時承接以下業務：(a) 小分子 NDA 產品的商業製造；(b) mAb 注射劑的 Phase 3 臨床試驗用藥製造（有 IND，無 BLA）；(c) 藥物-器械組合產品（Drug-Device Combination Product，有 FDA 已批准的 NDA）的充填加工。針對每個業務，列出適用的 CFR Parts。
blocks.en: Regulatory applicability matrix: A CDMO takes on the following work at the same time: (a) commercial manufacture of a small-molecule NDA product; (b) manufacture of Phase 3 clinical trial material for a mAb injectable (with an IND, no BLA); (c) filling and processing of a drug-device combination product (with an FDA-approved NDA). For each business, list the applicable CFR Parts.

blocks.zh: 483 情境分析： FDA 查廠時發現：(a) 批次記錄中有 3 個步驟的 in-process 測試結果空白，生產操作員說「那幾個步驟數值都在範圍內，只是忘記記錄」；(b) QA 部門說「我們口頭評估後決定可以放行，因為成品檢驗全部通過」。這違反哪些 Part 211 條款？FDA 最可能開立什麼層級的法規行動，理由是什麼？
blocks.en: 483 scenario analysis: During an FDA inspection, the following are found: (a) in-process test results for 3 steps are blank in the batch record, and the production operator says "the values for those steps were all within range, we just forgot to record them"; (b) the QA department says "we assessed it verbally and decided it could be released, because all the finished-product tests passed". Which Part 211 provisions does this violate? What level of regulatory action is FDA most likely to take, and why?

blocks.zh: 風險評估： 你的 CDMO 剛接到通知，FDA 將對工廠進行 For-Cause Inspection（起因：一位前員工向 FDA 匿名舉報數據篡改）。作為 QA Director，在查廠前 2 週，你優先做哪 5 件準備工作？每件工作對應哪個 Part 211 條款？
blocks.en: Risk assessment: Your CDMO has just been notified that FDA will conduct a For-Cause Inspection of the plant (triggered by a former employee anonymously reporting data falsification to FDA). As QA Director, what 5 preparations would you prioritize in the 2 weeks before the inspection? Which Part 211 provision does each one correspond to?

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠結果等級：對 CDMO 業務的實際衝擊
blocks.en: FDA Inspection Classifications: The Real Impact on CDMO Business

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 人員只知道 NAI/VAI/OAI 的定義，但不清楚這些等級對業務的實際影響。
blocks.en: Many CDMO staff know only the definitions of NAI/VAI/OAI, but are unclear about the real business impact of these classifications.

blocks.zh: 重點： OAI 的衝擊遠超過工廠本身的合規問題，會直接影響 CDMO 的所有客戶的法規申請狀態，造成整個業務的連鎖危機。這是為什麼 CGMP 合規在 CDMO 是優先級最高的業務風險，而非單純的技術要求。
blocks.en: Key point: The impact of an OAI goes far beyond the plant's own compliance problems; it directly affects the regulatory filing status of all of the CDMO's clients and causes a chain crisis across the whole business. This is why CGMP compliance is the highest-priority business risk at a CDMO, rather than a purely technical requirement.

blocks.zh: 本章小結：建立你的 21 CFR 210/211 心智模型
blocks.en: Chapter Summary: Building Your Mental Model of 21 CFR 210/211

blocks.zh: 在深入學習 Part 211 各子章節之前，請確保心中已建立以下框架：
blocks.en: Before going deeper into the subparts of Part 211, make sure you have built the following framework in your mind:
